newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police arrest 39 in anti-Mafia raids.
newsitem.headline: Italian police arrest 39 in anti-Mafia raids.

text.p: Police on Thursday carried out a round-up of people accused of Mafia activities, including a member of the carabinieri paramilitary police, in southern Italy.
More than 200 officers carried out raids in the region of Basilicata, southeast of Naples.
Twenty eight suspects were arrested in various towns on or near the Adriatic coast while fresh arrest warrants were served on 11 others already in prison.
Police sources said the Carabinieri officer was suspected of aiding drug trafficking activities.
The others were accused of a variety of crimes, including usury, extortion, robbery and several murders linked to the Naples Mafia, or Camorra, and other groups.
